### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version

### Module(s)

mini.statusline

### Description

when you have `laststatus = 3` and `set_vim_settings = false` (which is reccomeded for a global statusline) the statusline disappears when you do `:Lazy` 

### Neovim version

tested on latest stable and also latest Neovim nightly (NVIM v0.10.0-dev-2098+g92672a161))

### Steps to reproduce

minimal.lua: 

```lua
local root = vim.fn.fnamemodify("./.repro", ":p")

for _, name in ipairs({ "config", "data", "state", "cache" }) do
	vim.env[("XDG_%s_HOME"):format(name:upper())] = root .. "/" .. name
end

local lazypath = root .. "/plugins/lazy.nvim"
if not vim.loop.fs_stat(lazypath) then
	vim.fn.system({ "git", "clone", "--filter=blob:none", "https://github.com/folke/lazy.nvim.git", lazypath })
end
vim.opt.runtimepath:prepend(lazypath)

vim.opt.laststatus = 3

local plugins = {
	"catppuccin/nvim",

	{
		"echasnovski/mini.statusline",
		version = false,
		config = function()
			require("mini.statusline").setup({
				use_icons = true,

				-- when this is false and laststatus is set to 3 the statusline disappears instead of getting inactive
				set_vim_settings = false,
			})
		end,
	},
}

require("lazy").setup(plugins, {
	root = root .. "/plugins",
})

vim.cmd.colorscheme("catppuccin")

```

1. `nvim -nu minimal.lua`
2. `:Lazy` 


### Expected behavior

mini.statusline should get inactive instead of disappearing

### Actual behavior

the mini.statusline disappears and you see the default statusline

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

After doing some investigating, the reason seems to be similar to [this comment](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/issues/653#issuecomment-1891020568). In short: 'folke/lazy.nvim' opens floating window [with `noautocmd = true` config value](https://github.com/folke/lazy.nvim/blob/96584866b9c5e998cbae300594d0ccfd0c464627/lua/lazy/view/init.lua#L56) which disables certain events from getting triggered thus making 'mini.statusline' without needs to properly set value of 'statusline' option.

Another point to why this is not a 'mini.statusline' issue is because the value of 'statusline' option appears to be cleared (`=vim.inspect(vim.wo.statusline)` prints `""`) which is never done in 'mini.statusline'.

To show active statusline when inside floating window of 'lazy.nvim', users can create a `FileType` autocommand to force `statusline` to show `MiniStatusline.active()`. Something like this:

```lua
local set_active_stl = function() vim.wo.statusline = '%!v:lua.MiniStatusline.active()' end
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('Filetype', { pattern = 'lazy', callback = set_active_stl })
```

------

Closing as most certainly not a 'mini.statusline' issue.

title: statusline turns to the default one when you do `:Lazy` instead of getting inactive in the global stausline config
